title: Drone Gun
description: Even more Cyberpunk, apparently the claims of 4 drones struck down was nothing but a marketing campaign. Especially evident given that the dude’s scope is on backwards.

bookmarks.title: This gun downed four drones at Brazil's presidential inauguration
bookmarks.description: Federal law enforcement officials at Sunday's inauguration ceremony for Brazil's president-elect, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, say they used an anti-drone gun to bring down four "suspicious" aircraft heading toward the president. According to reports, Brazilian presidential security utilized DroneGun Tactical, a long-range counter-drone system developed by US/Australian company DroneShield.

bookmarks.title: Anti drone weapon used by a Brazilian agent in Brazil's presidential inauguration.
